subject.title: feat(sync): forward receipts and chat presence over the webhook

question: Should the new webhook event contract be opt-in only, preserving the exact legacy message JSON whenever `--webhook-events` is omitted?
rationale: The PR adds a public webhook schema and changes the default serialization contract; maintainers need to choose whether existing consumers may be required to tolerate a new field or whether compatibility is mandatory.

options.title: Preserve the legacy default
options.body: Keep the existing message payload unchanged when the flag is omitted, and emit the discriminator only for an explicitly selected expanded event contract.

options.title: Adopt the additive default
options.body: Document that all existing webhook consumers must accept `EventType` as a deliberate public contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve the legacy default
recommendation.body: Keep the existing message payload unchanged when the flag is omitted, and emit the discriminator only for an explicitly selected expanded event contract.
